items.item:
4. After a session ends the store holds no record of it: neither its set, its
   active project, its pending request nor its access version.
   Shows A11-1. [witness: verification:registry_a11_ended_session_leaves_no_record]
statements:
```text
end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1
register(x) after end(x) => granted(x) = {} and active(x) = none   -- A11-2
```

verdicts.why: The check detects any remaining session-table row naming either successfully ended session, so it asserts that no stored record—including its set, active project, pending request, or access version—remains. It does not separately assert that either ended identity is unregistered, such as by checking refusal, session listing, or re-registration behavior.
